name: k8s-restore-order-api
description: Restore the published staging/orders/order-api Deployment to three replicas and verify rollout.

commands.exec: test -r /etc/jiuwenswarm-autoops/kubernetes/autoops-development.kubeconfig && /opt/JiuwenSwarm/bin/kubectl --kubeconfig /etc/jiuwenswarm-autoops/kubernetes/autoops-development.kubeconfig --context autoops-development --namespace staging scale deployment/order-api --replicas=3 && /opt/JiuwenSwarm/bin/kubectl --kubeconfig /etc/jiuwenswarm-autoops/kubernetes/autoops-development.kubeconfig --context autoops-development --namespace staging rollout status deployment/order-api --timeout=120s
